classification.reason: This is a documented known issue (KI-101) in known_issues.md about CSV export omitting assignees for multi-assignee tasks, with a documented workaround, so it can be answered without human review.

draft.reply:
Hi there,

Thanks for reporting this, and yes — this is a known issue. When a task has more than one assignee, the CSV export can occasionally omit the "Assignee" column for that task (showing only one assignee or none at all). A fix is expected in an upcoming release.

In the meantime, the recommended workaround is to use the JSON export instead of CSV, as it correctly includes all assignees for multi-assignee tasks.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and thanks for your patience while we work on a fix!
